rationale: The material prompt requirement is Public-release preparation for an existing TypeScript CLI, including synchronized branch setup, repository inspection, governance files/templates, architecture/development/deployment/changelog documentation, package metadata, ignore rules, acceptance-check reporting, and maintainer review items..
